item.title: Howard student hosts “I Have a Dream” Clothing Drive - The Hilltop
item.description: Blaire Jones, a junior biology major, hosted an “I Have a Dream” clothing drive during MLK Day weekend. item.title: BTS album teaser controversy sparks discussion among Howard students - The Hilltop
item.description: K-Pop group BTS released an animated teaser to promote their fifth studio album, “Arirang.” The animation depicted Howard University, though the lack of Black people prompted controversy.
